expr: (() => { const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const S=window.simState; return s.length===1 && s[0].value==='1' && R[0].value==='1' && R[1].value==='0.15' && R[2].value==='0' && S.n===1 && S.T===2.4 && S.sat===0.15 && S.sys===0 && S.last===2.18 && S.mean===2.18 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: n = 1, satunnaisvirhe 0,15 s, systemaattinen virhe 0, speed normaali, first reading 2,18 s, not running (must run before any setup)
three sliders: toistoja n 1-40 step 1, satunnaisvirhe 0-0,3 s step 0,05, systemaattinen virhe -0,3-+0,3 s step 0,05
speed select hidas 0.5, normaali 1, nopea 2

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Käynnistä first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')]; const t=L.map(x=>simText(x)); return L.length===4 && /^Toistoja \$n = \d+\$$/.test(t[0]) && /^Satunnaisvirhe \$\\delta_\\text\{sat\} = .*\\,\\text\{s\}\$$/.test(t[1]) && /^Systemaattinen virhe \$\\delta_\\text\{sys\} = [+-].*\\,\\text\{s\}\$$/.test(t[2]) && t[3].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four labelled controls: Toistoja n, Satunnaisvirhe with unit s, Systemaattinen virhe with sign and unit s, Nopeus (toisto)

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words (explanations live in the lesson's inquiry.json)

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='n,sat,sys' && P.sat.unit==='s' && P.sys.unit==='s' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares n, sat (s) and sys (s)
